Katie (People Ops): Heads up — the SF office on 5th & Mission will be closed tomorrow (Thu) AM due to an unexpected HVAC outage. Facilities says safe to return after 1pm but we're keeping the office closed until further notice. Please work remote in the morning.
Mike L: Thanks — do we have ETA for repairs? I have a client on-site at 2pm.
facilities-bot: HVAC vendor ETA 12:30pm. Initial assessment: compressor failure, scheduled repairs 12:30–3:00pm. Building ops recommends no re-entry until tested.
Katie (People Ops): Good Q — if you need a meeting room for client visits, DM me and we'll rebook a nearby coworking room for the afternoon. Also: reminder about next week's SF onsite (Mon–Wed) — travel stipend + hotel block details below.
Jamal: Onsite travel Q — is the stipend per night or a lump sum? Also, can I switch hotel to a family suite? My partner's joining on personal time.
Katie (People Ops): Stipend is $200/day (meals/incidentals). We covered hotel for the official nights (Mon–Tue). If you need a family suite, book and keep receipts — submit via Expensify and we'll reimburse the difference subject to approval. If you need help booking, ping me.
Yasmin: Any plans for accessibility accommodations at the onsite? I need a quiet room for calls and will bring my own seating.
Katie (People Ops): Yes — we reserved a quiet room and there's an accessibility contact onsite (Olivia) who'll coordinate seating/AV. @Olivia can you confirm?
Olivia: Confirmed — quiet room reserved on 2nd floor for block hours 9am–5pm. Reach out if specific A/V or seating adjustments needed. I'll add a calendar invite link shortly.
Dan: Re travel: is there a company rate for car service from SFO? Late flights arriving ~11pm.
Katie (People Ops): We have a negotiated Lyft Business rate; for arrivals after 10pm, use the ridesheet, mark expense as 'late arrival' and submit. If you prefer an airport shuttle, let me know and we'll arrange.
Mike L: Got it. For tomorrow's closure, I'll move the 2pm client to a coworking room. Thx!
Katie (People Ops): Thanks all — we'll post another update here if anything changes. If you need urgent help re: bookings or childcare/daycare for onsite days, DM me or book a slot on my calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/katie.
facilities-bot: Building reopened at 13:45 after HVAC verification tests. All-caps: Please confirm when you re-enter the building.
Katie (People Ops): Marking this thread resolved — reply if you re-entered or need further help. :handshake:
